source_artifacts.claim: Current room definition pins light cargo, three pads, gates, two slime gaps, and both exits.
Pad occupancy, hold/latch behavior, and platform effects are implemented here.
A light crate moves with one connected pusher.

prior_knowledge.concept: Matching exits and hold/latch cooperative pads

evidence.claim: First campaign room defines both exits and a hold-to-rescue gate handoff.

prior_knowledge.concept: Moving ferry with brake and power dependency

evidence.claim: Earlier ferry room defines a moving platform and brake control.
Earlier bridge room defines collapse timing and Pac stabilization.

prior_knowledge.concept: Single-pusher light crate on an any pad

evidence.claim: Earlier room has a light crate and any-pad arrangement.
Earlier marrow room gives a five-of-eight powered mover.

prior_knowledge.concept: Light cargo parked as brake/power holder while Pac steadies bridge and Isp latches rescue

evidence.claim: Current room combines earlier devices in a new causal handoff.

mechanics.fact: The cargo is light. One hero can push it onto the any BRAKE hold pad; a crate contributes weight on any pads.

evidence.claim: BRAKE accepts any and cargo is not heavy.
One pusher suffices for non-heavy cargo.
Any pad counts ordinary crate weight.

mechanics.fact: BRAKE stops and powers the ferry and opens the Pac island gate while occupied, overriding its five-of-eight power cycle.

evidence.claim: Power cycle and BRAKE effects are defined.
Active effects stop motor, power platform, and open door.

mechanics.fact: Pac must hold STEADY to stabilize the unstable bridge and open Isp bridge gate; Isp RESCUE latches those effects and opens Pac finish gate.

evidence.claim: STEADY hold and RESCUE latch effects.
Hold ends when unoccupied; latch persists.

mechanics.fact: Both uncovered pits have slime below; a fall below the world also kills. Death resets the room after 0.6 seconds.

evidence.claim: Two slime hazards cover the gaps.
Hazard contact and deep fall set dead status.
Death increments retries and rebuilds initial state after 0.6 seconds.

mechanics.fact: Collectibles belong separately to Isp and Pac and are not required for exit completion.

evidence.claim: Both matching exits, not collectibles, complete an ordinary room.

legal_routes.name: Accepted ordinary keyboard clear via cargo brake, Pac steady, Isp rescue

steps.action: Walk Pac right through the light cargo to BRAKE, then jump clear toward the ferry.
steps.expected_feedback: Cargo holds BRAKE, stopping and powering the ferry while opening Pac island gate.

evidence.claim: Accepted route begins Pac walk to 240 then jump to 330.

steps.action: Cross via ferry to the island and stand Pac on STEADY.
steps.expected_feedback: Bridge remains stable and Isp bridge gate opens while Pac occupies STEADY.

evidence.claim: Accepted route moves Pac to 625 and 650 before Isp crosses.

steps.action: Cross ferry and bridge while Pac holds STEADY, then reach ISP RESCUE at the far side.
steps.expected_feedback: RESCUE permanently preserves power, doors, and bridge stabilization, releasing Pac.

evidence.claim: Accepted route jumps Isp through island and bridge to 945.
RESCUE is an Isp latch with persistent effects.

steps.action: Move Pac past the finish gate to the orange exit and Isp to the blue exit.
steps.observed_feedback: Accepted built-browser route ended complete with zero retries; this supports feasibility for those inputs, not novice discovery.

evidence.claim: Route finishes Pac to 1035 and Isp to 955.
Room 12 ordinary route is scripted in the accepted campaign.

isp: Crosses the ferry and Pac-stabilized bridge to latch RESCUE, making the held effects permanent.
Reaches the blue exit after opening Pac finish passage.
pac: Pushes the light cargo onto BRAKE in the accepted route; either hero could supply this single-pusher role.
Occupies STEADY long enough for Isp to reach RESCUE, then reaches the orange exit.

common_mistakes.mistake: Failing to park cargo fully on BRAKE, or moving it off before crossing.
common_mistakes.consequence: Source predicts ferry loses BRAKE power/stop override and Pac island gate closes; the cycle can also pause ferry movement.
common_mistakes.recovery: Return to the start and push the light crate fully onto BRAKE. If a fall reaches slime, the room resets after death.

evidence.claim: BRAKE is a hold pad controlling ferry power/motor and Pac island gate.

common_mistakes.mistake: Pac leaves STEADY before Isp reaches RESCUE.
common_mistakes.consequence: Source predicts Isp bridge gate closes and unstabilized bridge may collapse after 0.8 seconds occupied.
common_mistakes.recovery: Pac can reoccupy STEADY; an already collapsed bridge respawns after two seconds, while a slime fall restarts the room.

evidence.claim: Unstable bridge collapse and reset durations.

common_mistakes.mistake: A hero misses the ferry or bridge and falls into slime.
common_mistakes.consequence: Hazard contact or deep fall kills, increments retries, and loses the current cargo/pad setup.
common_mistakes.recovery: Automatic fresh state after 0.6 seconds; rebuild cargo BRAKE and repeat crossings.

evidence.claim: Retry and fresh state after 0.6 seconds.

optional_collectibles: Isp blue cargo spark at x280 and Pac orange island spark at x670 are optional; accepted route happened to collect 2/2.

reasoning.rationale: Mandatory causal order is park cargo on BRAKE, hold STEADY with Pac, send Isp to latch RESCUE, then release Pac.

cooperation.rationale: The non-heavy cargo needs only one pusher, but Pac must hold STEADY while Isp crosses to RESCUE: one distinct-role handoff.

execution.rationale: Both heroes traverse ferry and two exposed gap crossings, with Isp reaching far RESCUE before Pac follows.

evidence.claim: Multiple accepted jumps and walks for both heroes.

timing.rationale: The mandatory accepted route parks cargo on BRAKE, stopping and continuously powering ferry, and Pac holds bridge stable; no active window remains required.

evidence.claim: Accepted route clears without a timed waiting step.

hazards.rationale: Two slime pits flank the ferry and unstable bridge; a missed crossing causes lethal exposure but broad platform staging exists.

novelty.rationale: Prior light crate, ferry, Pac bridge, and rescue latch return as a cargo-held brake followed by a Pac-to-Isp handoff.

recovery_cost.rationale: Slime death resets crate and pad progress, while leaving STEADY safely permits reoccupancy or bridge respawn.

solution_clarity.rationale: Cargo-first subtitle and pad labels point to initial action; hidden multi-effect BRAKE and RESCUE still require causal testing.

evidence.claim: Route demonstrates sequence; it does not prove novice clarity.

control_friction.rationale: Distinct mapped key sets operated in the accepted route with no reported input conflict; this verifies functional shared-keyboard control for the route, not human comfort.

evidence.claim: Ordinary keyboard API and separate controls.

confidence_reason: Current source explains each dependency and accepted ordinary-input browser route completed without retries. Human discovery, comfort, and alternate-route ease remain unmeasured.

confirmed: Cargo-first cue, moving ferry, Pac STEADY, Isp RESCUE, two slime gaps, and both matching exits correspond to actual authored mechanics.
Visible two-role handoff and optional sparks were appropriately separated from the mandatory goal.
missed_mechanics: BRAKE accepts and is held by the light cargo; the pair need not push a heavy object together.
BRAKE continuously powers and stops the ferry while occupied, removing its five-on/three-off window from the accepted mandatory route.
STEADY opens Isp gate and stabilizes the bridge; RESCUE is a latch that preserves these effects and opens Pac finish gate.
incorrect_inferences: Pass one grouped colored barriers with Cana five-on/three-off timing; the barriers are pad-operated, while the cycle belongs to ferry power.
Pass one suggested Isp needed to use ANY BRAKE, but the accepted route has Pac push cargo and leave it parked.
changed_judgments: Timing 2 to 0: BRAKE cargo occupancy overrides the cycle and stops the ferry; the demonstrated route has no mandatory active window.
Recovery null to 2: slime/fall death rebuilds the room, but safe STEADY release can be reversed or bridge respawns.
Solution clarity 3 to 2: cargo-first cue and labeled role pads reveal more order than idle frames could confirm.
Control friction null to 0: accepted ordinary keyboard inputs complete this route without a verified conflict.
unresolved: No observed human attempt establishes first-encounter comprehension, enjoyment, or distribution of errors.
The accepted route proves one clear only; exact ease of other legal cargo/ferry approaches remains untested.

single_operator_note: One operator must alternate WASD and arrow keys while parking cargo, holding Pac steady, and moving Isp. This adds coordination demand beyond the two-human baseline; no human one-operator attempt was observed.
